name: Reentrancy
threat_model: An untrusted contract depositor re-enters an ETH vault through its receive hook before the withdrawal ledger is updated, potentially taking more ETH than its credit.
assumptions: ETH is the asset held and paid by the vault.
The attacker can call withdraw from a contract receive hook.
The example focuses on same-contract reentrancy and does not model cross-contract accounting.
invariant: A caller can withdraw at most the amount credited to that caller.

detector_expectations.expectation: expected on VulnerableVault; absent from SafeVault
must not fire on the remediated contract
